item.title: Have your say on heavy vehicle charges shake-up
item.description: The FLCB is an alternative approach that spreads the cost of road construction and maintenance over the useful life of assets. Image: darkydoors/stock.adobe.com Truck owners are now invited to have their say on a proposed new forward-looking cost base (FLCB) model for heavy vehicle charges. The FLCB system could replace the long-running pay-as-you-go (PAYGO) model from 2027-28 onwards, if transport ministers sign off later this year. item.title: Truck driver charged with manslaughter after four-truck crash on Hume
item.description: Police laid two additional charges of manslaughter and cause bodily harm by misconduct. Image: NSW Police A truckie has been charged with two additional offences, including manslaughter, following a fatal four-truck crash on the Hume Highway near Gundagai, NSW, earlier last year. The incident occurred at around 1.45am on Friday, January 3, 2025, near Spring Dam Road, Coolac, 18km north of Gundagai.
